news.headline: Crude firm: WTI +1.3%, Brent ~$111-116 near 6-month high
news.what_happened: Attacks on Saudi Arabia keep supply-disruption fears alive; Brent near six-month highs.
news.why_it_matters: Higher crude lifts upstream realisations and pressures airlines, paints, tyres and India's import bill and inflation.

news.headline: Nifty flat at 22,749.75; Fed decision due tonight
news.what_happened: Sensex/Nifty ended flat on Oct 27 (F&O expiry); smallcaps +2.7%, Nifty Bank -0.7%, IT weak (TCS -1.5%).
news.why_it_matters: Markets wait for the Fed; a hawkish tone would pressure EM flows.

news.headline: US stocks up: S&P +0.6%, Nasdaq +1.2%
news.what_happened: Wall Street closed higher overnight; Nikkei +1.2%, Hang Seng flat.
news.why_it_matters: Supportive global cue, though FII selling (record YTD outflow) caps upside.

sector_outlook.reason: Nasdaq +1.2% vs weak sentiment and flat rupee

picks.logic: Upstream realisation per barrel rises directly with crude; ONGC earnings are highly crude-sensitive.
Oil India is a pure upstream producer; higher realisations flow to profit.

risks: US Fed decision tonight - hawkish tone could hit EM flows
